mapper.select: SELECT s.*, wc.`name` AS customer_name, wu.user_name AS inviter_name FROM we_live_statistic s LEFT JOIN we_customer wc ON wc.external_userid = s.external_userid AND wc.corp_id = s.corp_id LEFT JOIN we_user wu ON wu.user_id = s.inviter_userid AND wu.corp_id = s.corp_id WHERE s.item_id = #{itemId} AND s.corp_id = #{corpId} ORDER BY s.enter_time DESC
